name: Pengkin Rimejarl
biography:
Pingvius erectus. A silver-tongued pengkin jarl whose psionic whispers corrupt magical communication for sixty feet in every direction — and who is perfectly happy to settle arguments by sliding into you at speed. Habitat: Arctic.

Gear: Quarterstaff.

features.name: Maddening Whispers
features.description: The pengkin exudes an aura that corrupts psionic abilities in a 60-foot Emanation originating from it. When a creature attempts to communicate magically within that area by an effect other than the pengkin's telepathy (such as by the Message or Sending spells), the effect fails, and the creature takes 3 (1d6) Psychic damage. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

features.name: Slide (1/Turn)
features.description: If the pengkin is Prone, it can slide across flat surfaces instead of crawling and has a Speed of 35 feet while doing so. If the pengkin gives itself the Prone condition voluntarily, it can right itself and end the condition without expending any movement.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Ability: Charisma; DC: 15; Modifier: +7. The pengkin is an innate spellcaster and doesn't require Material components.

At Will: Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Ray of Frost (level 5 caster)

4/Day: Brainfreeze*, Coldsnap*, Detect Thoughts (C)

1/Day Each: Black Tentacles (C), Dream

*See the spell pages of the Field Notes PDF; (C) indicates Concentration.

features.name: Quarterstaff
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Cold damage.

features.name: Ray of Frost (Cantrip)
features.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7, range 60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d8) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of the rimejarl's next turn.
